name: Hyper Typhlosion
description1: The fire shooting out it is pure, concentrated Hyper energy. As such, it is hotter than any real-world flame and cannot be extinguished by regular means.
description2: Typhlosion's volcanic blasts are so hot, they hurt the Pokemon itself. For some reason, it appears as though it enjoys the pain.

name: Hyper Torterra
description1: The tree on its back grows the more life there is in the world. It's said if you eat one of its fruits, your wish will be granted.
description2: Where Torterra roams, strange mutated plants begin to flourish. It is unknown if the plants are from the past or future.

name: Hyper Inteleon
description1: Its tails have mutated into two launchers that can blast water. The pressure of these shots are so great they can cut through steel.
description2: With the increase to firepower, Inteleon's personality has shifted. It prefers all-out attacking as opposed to stealth.

name: Hyper Toxicroak
description1: It generates so much poison that its body can no longer contain it. This poison influences the atmosphere.
description2: It no longer needs to actively hunt prey. It merely waits for the acid downpour to weaken its enemies before finishing them off with a single scratch.

name: Hyper Ditto
description1: Hyper-Ditto can improve upon what it copies. Its transformations correct weaknesses in the original, making its imitations superior.
description2: Its body is uniquely reactive to Hyper energy. Its possible the first ditto were born from this energy.
